international.title: Saudi Arabia challenged by Yemeni allies over ceding ground to Houthis
international.summary: Strategy of redeploying forces to try to relieve siege of Taiz and protect Aden comes as Islamist group makes steady gains Saudi Arabia has been accused by anti-Houthi forces over its military strategy after its Yemeni allies withdrew troops from the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait, as well as pulled back forces from parts of Marib in the central part of the country. The Saudi-backed government explained the repositioning by saying the strategic priority is to break the attritional siege on Taiz , Yemen’s third city and to protect Aden, the southern port city in which the Saudi-backed and UN-recognised government is now based.
